a: Loke achat.
Vezar sheachalah – loke shetayim. sheillu battechilla achalah – eno loke ella achat.
Tama deiteh birushalayim, ha bigvulin – loke shalosh, deaf al gav delav roe pene choma! deayyeylay[] veappekay[].
I hachi may lememra? hacha bemay askinan – kegon deayyeylinhu betivlayyhu, vekasavar: mattanot shello huremu – kemi shehuremu damyayn.

Vesavar rabbi yose mattanot shello huremu kemi shehuremu dame? vehatanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al perot shello nigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim – sheyyippade maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel bechol makom.

Veal ma nechleku – al perot shennigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim, shebbet shammay omrim: yachzir maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim, uvet hillel omrim: yippade veyeachel bechol makom. vei salka datach mattanot shello huremu kemi shehuremu damyayn – ha kelatuhu mechitzot!
Amar rabba: mechitza leechol deorayyta, mechitza liklot – derabbanan. vechi gezur rabbanan – ki iteh beeneh, betivleh la gezur rabbanan.
Ravina amar: kegon denaket leh bekanya. vetifshot baya derav pappa.

Mishna hakkoreach korcha berosho vehammakkif peat rosho, vehammashchit peat zekano, vehassoret serita achat al hammet – chayyayv. sarat serita achat al chamishsha metim, o chamesh seritot al met echad – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Al harosh – shetayim, achat mikkan veachat mikkan, al hazzakan – shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan, veachat millematta. rabbi eliezer omer: im nittelu kullan keachat – eno chayyayv ella achat.
Veeno chayyayv ad sheyyittelennu betaar. rabbi eliezer omer: afillu likketo bemalket o birhitani – chayyayv.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "lo yikrechu", yachol afillu karach arba vechamesh kerichot lo yehe chayyayv ella achat? talmud lomar "korcha" – lechayyev al kol korcha vekorcha. "berosham" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "lo titgoddu velo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet", yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella al ben haenayim bilvad, minnayin lerabbot kol harosh? talmud lomar "berosham" – lerabbot kol harosh.
Veen li ella bakkohanim, sheribba bahen hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot, yisrael minnayin?

Neemar kan "korcha" veneemar lehallan "korcha", ma lehallan chayyayv al kol korcha vekorcha, vechayyayv al harosh keven haenayim – af kan chayyayv al kol korcha vekorcha, vechayyayv al harosh keven haenayim. uma lehallan al met – af kan al met.
Hane arba vechamesh kerichot hechi dame? illema beze achar ze, uvechamesh hateraot – peshita!
b: Ella bachada hateraa, mi michayyayv? vehatnan: nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom – eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo: "al tishte", "al tishte", vehu shote – chayyayv al kol achat veachat! la tzericha, desach chamesh etzbeotav nasha veotvinhu bevat achat, dehavya leh, hateraa lechol chada vachada.

Vechamma shiur korcha? rav huna omer: kede sheyyerae merosho. rabbi yochanan omer mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: kigris. ketannae: kamma shiur korcha – kigris, acherim omrim: kede sheyyerae merosho.

Amar rav yehuda bar chaviva: peligi ba telata tannae, chad omer: kigris, vechad omer: kede sheyyerae merosho, vechad omer: kishte searot. veikka demappek shete searot umeayyel bechaadasha. vesimanach: baheret – kigris, umichya – bechaadasha.
Tana: hannotel melo pi hazzug bashshabbat – chayyayv. vechamma melo pi hazzug? amar rav yehuda: shetayim. vehatanya: lakkorcha shetayim! ema: vechen lakkorcha shetayim.

Tanya name hachi: hannotel melo pi hazzug bashshabbat chayyayv, vechamma melo pi hazzug – shetayim. rabbi eliezer omer: achat. umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bimlakket levanot mittoch shechorot, afillu achat – shehu chayyayv. vedavar ze afillu bechol asur, mishshum shenneemar: "lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha".
Vehammakkif peat rosho vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "peat rosho" – sof rosho, veezehu sof rosho – ze hammashve tzedaav laachore ozno ulefaddachto.
Tane tanna kammeh derav chisda: echad hammakkif veechad hannikkaf – loke. amar leh: man deachel tamre bearbela lake? deamar lach: manni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: lav sheen bo maase lokin alav.
Rava omer: bemakkif leatzmo, vedivre hakkol. rav ashe omer: bimsayyea. vedivre hakkol.
Vehammashchit peat zekano. tanu rabbanan: peat zekano – sof zekano, veezehu sof zekano – shibbolet zekano.

Vehamesaret serita achat vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "veseret" – yachol afillu sarat al beto shennafal veal sefinato shettava bayyam? talmud lomar: "lenefesh" – eno chayyayv ella al hammet bilvad. uminnayin lamsaret chamesh seritot al met echad shehu chayyayv al kol achat veachat? talmud lomar: "veseret" – lechayyev al kol serita userita.
Rabbi yose omer: minnayin lamsaret serita achat al chamishsha metim, shehu chayyayv al kol achat veachat? talmud lomar "lenefesh" – lechayyev al kol nefesh vanefesh.
Veha appekteh leveto shennafal velisfinato shettava bayyam!

a: Kasavar rabbi yose: serita ugedida achat hi, uchetiv hatam "lemet".
Amar shemuel: hamesaret bichli – chayyayv. metivi: serita ugedida achat hi, ella shesserita bayyad ugedida bichli! hu deamar kerabbi yose.

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: al met, ben bayyad ben bichli – chayyayv, al avoda zara, bayyad – chayyayv, bichli – patur. veha ippecha ketiv: "vayyitgoddu kemishpatam bacharavot uvarmachim"! ella ema: bayyad – patur, bichli – chayyayv.
Vechayyayv al harosh. machve rav sheshet ben pirke resha. veal hazzakan, shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan veachat millematta. machve rav sheshet ben pirke dikna.
Rabbi eliezer omer: im netalan vechulei. kasavar: chad lav hu.

Veeno chayyayv ad sheyyittelennu betaar. tanu rabbanan: "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol afillu gallacho bemisparayim yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lo tashchit". i "lo tashchit", yachol im likketo bemalket urehitani yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lo yegallechu".
Ha ketzad – gilluach sheyyesh bo hashechata, heve omer ze taar.
Rabbi eliezer omer: afillu likketo bemalket urehitani yehe chayyayv. ma nafshach: i gemir gezera shava – live taar, i la gemir gezera shava – misparayim name [la]!
Leolam gemir gezera shava, vekasavar: hane name gilluach avdi.

Mishna hakkotev ketovet kaaka. katav velo kiaka, kiaka velo katav – eno chayyayv, ad sheyyichtov vikaka (beyado) [bidyo] uvichchol uvechol davar shehu roshem. rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer: eno chayyayv ad sheyyichtov sham et hashshem, shenneemar: "uchetovet kaaka lo tittenu bachem ani Adonai".

Gemara amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ad deyichtov "ani Adonai" mammash? amar leh: la. kidtane bar kappara: eno chayyayv ad sheyyichtov shem avoda zara, shenneemar: "uchetovet kaaka lo tittenu bachem ani Adonai" – ani Adonai, velo acher.

Amar rav malkiyya amar rav adda bar ahava: asur lo leadam sheyyitten efer mikle al gabbe makkato, mippene shenniret kichtovet kaaka. amar rav nachman bereh derav ika: shappud, shefachot vegumot – rav malkiyyo, belorit, efer mikle ugevina – rav malkiyya
Rav pappa amar: matnitin umatnita – rav malkiyya, shematata – rav malkiyyo. vesimanaych: matnita malketa. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shefachot.
Rav bivi bar abbaye kafed afillu arivda dechusilta. rav ashe amar: kol makom sheyyesh sham makka – makkato mochiach alav.

Mishna nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom – en chayyayv ella achat. amru lo "al tishte", "al tishte", vehu shote – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom – eno chayyayv ella achat, amru lo "al tittamme", "al tittamme", vehu mittamme – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. haya megalleach kol hayyom – eno chayyayv ella achat, amru lo "al tegalleach", "al tegalleach", vehu megalleach – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Haya lavush bechilayim kol hayyom – eno chayyayv ella achat, amru lo: "al tilbash", "al tilbash", vehu poshet velovesh – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
b: Yesh choresh telem echad vechayyayv alav mishshum shemona lavin: hachoresh beshor vachamor, vehen mukedashin, vechilayim bakkerem, uvashsheviit, veyom tov, vechohen venazir bevet hattumea.
Chananya ben chachinay omer: af hallovesh kilayim. amru lo: eno hashshem. amar lahem: af hannazir lo hu hashshem.

Gemara amar rav bivi amar rabbi yose: "poshet velovesh" – lovesh mammash, o afillu machnis umotzi bet yad unekle shello? machve rav acha bereh derav ika: ayyole veappoke. rav ashe omer: afillu lo shaha ella kede lifshot velilbosh – chayyayv.

Yesh choresh telem vechulei. amar rabbi yannay: bachavura nimnu vegamru: hachofe bechilayim – loke. amar lahen rabbi yochanan: lav mishnatenu hi zo? yesh choresh telem echad vechayyayv alav mishshum shemona lavin: hachoresh beshor uvachamor vehen mukedashin, vechilayim bakkerem – hay choresh demichayyayv mishshum kilayim hechi mashkachat la? lav demikkasse bahadeh deazel?

Amar leh: i lav dedallay lach chaspa, mi mashkachat marganita tuta? amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: i lav dekayllesach gavra rabba, hava amena: matnitin manni – rabbi akiva hi, deamar: hamekayyem kilayim – loke.
May rabbi akiva? detanya: hamenakkesh vehamechappe bechilayim – loke. rabbi akiva omer: af hamekayyem.
May tama derabbi akiva? detanya: "sadcha lo tizra kilayim" – en li ella zorea, mekayyem minnayin? talmud lomar: "behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim".
Amar leh ulla lerav nachman: velilke name mishshum zorea beyom tov! amar leh: tena veshayyayr.
Amar leh: tanna katane shemona, veat amrat tena veshayyayr?! amar rava: yesh chilluk melachot beshabbat, veen chilluk melachot beyom tov. amar leh: ada tehe.

Etiveh abbaye: veen chilluk melachot beyom tov? vehatnan: hamevashshel gid bechalav beyom tov, vaachalo – loke chamesh. loke mishshum ochel gid, veloke mishshum mevashshel beyom tov shello letzorech, veloke mishshum mevashshel gid bechalav, veloke mishshum ochel basar bechalav, veloke

a: Mishshum haveara. veim ita, mishshum haveara la michayyayv, deha ichayyayv leh mishshum bishshulo! appek haveara veayyel gid hannashe shel nevela.

Vehatane rabbi chiyyay: loke shetayim al achilato veshalosh al bishshulo. vei ita, shalosh al achilato hu chayyayv! ella: appek haveara veayyel atze ashera, veazharteh mehacha: "velo yidbak beyadcha vegomer".

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: velilke name mishshum "lo tavi toeva el betecha"! ella: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shebbishshelo baatze hekdesh, veazharteh mehacha: "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh... lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem".
Siman. 363 357
Matkef la rav hoshaya: velichshov name hazzorea benachal etan, veazharteh mehacha: "asher lo yeaved bo velo yizzarea"!
Matkef la rav chananya: velichshov name hammochek et hashshem bahalichato, veazharteh mehacha: "veibbadtem et shemam vegomer (v)lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem"!
Matkef la rabbi avahu: velichshov name hakkotzetz et bahareto, veazharteh mehacha: "hishshamer benega hatztzaraat"!
Matkef la abbaye: velichshov name hammeziach hachoshen meal haefod, vehammesir badde aron, veazharteh mehacha: "(v)lo yasuru", "velo yizzach hachoshen"!
Matkef la rav ashe: velichshov name hachoresh baatze ashera, veazharteh mehacha: "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma vego"!
Matkef la ravina: velichshov name hakkotzetz ilanot tovot, veazharteh mehacha: "ki mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot"!

Amar leh rabbi zeera lerabbi mani: velichshov name kegon deamar "shevua shello echrosh beyom tov"! hatam la ka chala shevua, musheba veomed mehar sinay hu. amar leh: kegon deamar "shevua shello echrosh ben bachol ben beyom tov", demiggo dechala aleh shevua bechol – chala aleh name beyom tov! midde deiteh bishela la katane.
Vela? vahare hekdesh! bivchor. vahare nazir! binzir shimshon.
Nezir shimshon bar ittammoye lemetim hu? ella, hay tanna issur kolel let leh.
Amar rabbi hoshaya: hammarbia shor pesule hammukedashim – loke shenayim. amar rabbi yitzchak: hammanhig beshor pesule hammukedashim – loke, shehare guf echad hu, vaasao hakkatuv kishne gufim.
Mishna kamma malkin oto – arbaim chaser achat, shenneemar "bemispar arbaim" – minyan shehu samuch learbaim. rabbi yehuda omer: arbaim shelemot hu loke, vehechan hu loke et hayyetera – ben ketefav.
En omdin oto, ella bemakkot reuyot lehishtallesh. amaduhu lekabbel arbaim, veloke miktzat,
b: Veamdu sheen yachol lekabbel arbaim – patur. amaduhu lekabbel shemone esre, umishshellaka amdu sheyyachol hu lekabbel arbaim – patur.

Gemara may tama? i ketiv "arbaim bemispar" hava amena: arbaim beminyayna, hasheta dichtiv "bemispar arbaim" – minyan shehu sochem et haarbaim. amar rava: kamma tafshae shear inashe, dekayymi mikkamme sefer tora, vela kayymi mikkamme gavra rabba, deillu besefer tora ketiv "arbaim", vaato rabbanan betzaru chada.

Rabbi yehuda omer: arbaim shelemot vechulei. amar rabbi yitzchak: may tama derabbi yehuda – dichtiv "ma hammakkot haelle ben yadecha veamar asher hukketi bet meahavay". verabbanan? hahu betinokot shel bet rabban hu dichtiv.
En omdin ella bemakkot haruyot vechulei. laka – in, lo laka – la.
Ureminhu: amaduhu lekabbel arbaim, vechazru veamdu sheen yachol lekabbel arbaim – patur. amaduhu lekabbel shemone esre, vechazru vaamaduhu sheyyachol lekabbel arbaim – patur.
Amar rav sheshet: la kashya, ha – daamaduhu leyome, ha – daamaduhu limchar uleyoma uchera.
Mishna avar avera sheyyesh bah shene lavin, amaduhu omed echad – loke ufatur, veim lav – loke umitrappe, vechozer veloke.
Gemara vehatanya: en omdin omed echad lishne lavin!
Amar rav sheshet: la kashya, ha – daamaduhu learbaim vachada. ha – daamaduhu learbaim vetarte.

Mishna ketzad malkin oto? kofe shete yadav al haammud helach vehelach, vechazzan hakkeneset ochez bivgadav, im nikreu – nikreu, veim nifremu – nifremu, ad shehu megalle et libbo. vehaeven netuna meacharav. chazzan hakkeneset omed alav uretzua beyado, shel egel, kefula echad lishnayim ushenayim learbaa, ushete retzuot shel chamor olot veyordot bah. yadah tefach urechava tefach, veroshah maggaat al pi chereso.
Umakke oto shelish millefanav ushete yadot milleacharav. veeno makke oto lo omed velo yoshev, ella mutte, shenneemar "vehippilo hashshofet",

Vehammakke makke beyado achat bechol kocho, vehakkore kore: "im lo tishmor laasot vegomer", "vehifla Adonai et makkotcha veet makkot vegomer" vechozer litchillat hammikra: "ushemartem et divre habberit hazzot vegomer" vechotem: "vehu rachum yechapper avon", vegomer, vechozer litchillat hammikra.
Veim met tachat yado – patur. hosif lo od retzua achat umet – hare ze gole al yado. nitkalkel, ben berei ben bemayim – patur, rabbi yehuda omer: haish – berei, vehaishsha – bemayim.

a: Gemara may tama – mishshum "nikla".
Amar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: minnayin lirtzua shehi shel egel – dichtiv "arbaim yakkennu", usemich leh "lo tachsom shor bedisho".

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: minnayin livama shennafla lifne mukke shechin, sheen chosmin otah – dichtiv "lo tachsom shor bedisho", usemich leh "ki yeshvu achim yachdav vegomer".
Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamevazze et hammoadim keillu oved avoda zara, dichtiv "elohe massecha lo taase lach", usemich leh "et chag hammatztzot tishmor".

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamesapper lashon hara, vechen hamekabbel lashon hara, vechol hammeid edut sheker – rauy lehashelicho lichlavim, dichtiv "lakkelev tashlichun oto", usemich leh "lo tissa shema shav vegomer", keri beh name "lo tassi".

Ushete retzuot vechulei. tana: shel chamor. kiddaresh hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda: "yada shor konehu vachamor evus bealav yisrael lo yada vegomer", amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo mi shemmakkir evus bealav, veyippara mimmi sheeno makkir evus bealav.

Yadah tefach vechulei. amar abbaye: shema minna kol chad vechad lefum gabbeh avdinan leh. amar leh rava: im ken nappesh lehu retzuot tuva! ella amar rava: avkata it lay, ki bae meykattar bay, ki bae merappe ba.
Malkin oto vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera "vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav kede rishato bemispar" – risha achat millefanav, shete rishayot meacharav.

En malkin oto vechulei. amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin lirtzua shehi muchepelet – shenneemar "vehippilo". veha mibbee leh legufeh! im ken lichtov kera "yattehu", may "hippilo"? shema minna tarte.
Hammakke makke beyado. tanu rabbanan: en maamidin chazzanin ella chasere choach vitere madda. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu chasere madda vitere koach.

Amar rava: kevoteh derabbi yehuda mistabbera, dichtiv "lo yosif... pen yosif", i amrat bishlama chasere madda – hayeynu ditzrich leazhore. ella i amrat yetere madda – mi tzerich leazhore? verabbanan: en mezarzin ella lamzoraz.
Tana: keshehu magbiah – magbiah bishte yadav, ucheshehu makke – makke beyado achat, ki hechi (delete) [detete] middideh.

Vehakkore kore vechulei. tanu rabbanan: haggadol shebbaddayyaynin kore, hashsheni mone, vehashshelishi omer: "hakkehu"! bizman shemmakka merubba – maarich, bizman shemmakka muetet – mekatztzer. veha anan tenan: chozer litchillat hammikra! mitzva letzamtzem, vei[40] lo tzimtzem – chozer litchillat hammikra.
Tanu rabbanan: "makka rabba", en li ella makka rabba, makka muetet minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo yosif". im ken, ma talmud lomar "makka rabba"? limmed al harishonot shehen makka rabba.

Nitkalkel vechulei. tanu rabbanan: echad haish veechad haishsha berei velo bemayim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: haish berei, vehaishsha bemayim. vachachamim omrim: echad haish veechad haishsha – ben berei ben bemayim.
Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: echad haish veechad haishsha – berei! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shenehem shavin berei.

Amar shemuel: kefatuhu, veratz mibbet din – patur. metivi: kala, ben barishona ben bashsheniyya – potrin oto. nifseka retzua bashsheniyya – potrin oto, barishona – en potrin oto. ammay? leheve keratz! hatam ratz, hacha la ratz.

Tanu rabbanan: amaduhu lichsheyyilke kale – potrin oto. lichsheyyetze mibbet din kale – malkin oto. velo od ella, afillu kala battechilla – malkin oto shenneemar: "vehikkahu vegomer venikla" velo shellaka kevar bevet din.
Mishna kol chayyayve charetot shellaku – nifteru yede keritatam, shenneemar: "venikla achicha leenecha" – keshellaka hare hu keachicha, divre rabbi chananya ben gamliel.

Veamar rabbi chananya ben gamliel: ma im haover avera achat notel nafsho aleha, haose mitzva achat al achat kamma vechamma shettinnaten lo nafsho. rabbi shimon omer: mimmekomo hu lamed, shenneemar: "venichretu hannefashot haosot vegomer"
b: "Asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem". ha hayyoshev vela avar avera notnin lo sachar kaose mitzva.

Rabbi shimon bar rabbi omer: hare hu omer "rak chazak levilti achol (et) haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh vegomer" uma im haddam, shennafsho shel haadam katza mimmennu – happoresh mimmennu mekabbel sachar, gazel vaarayot, shennafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammadtan – happoresh mehen al achat kamma vechamma sheyyizke lo uledorotav uledorot dorotav ad sof kol haddorot.
Rabbi chananya ben akashya omer: ratza hakkadosh baruch hu lezakkot et yisrael, lefichach hirba lahem tora umitzvot, shenneemar "Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir".

Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi chananya ben gamliel. amar rav adda bar ahava: amri be rav, tenenan: en ben shabbat leyom hakkippurim ella shezze zedono bide adam veze zedono behikkaret. veim ita, idde veidde bide adam hu.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak omer: ha manni – rabbi yitzchak hi, deamar: malkot bechayyayve charetot lekka. detanya, rabbi yitzchak omer: chayyayve charetot bakkelal hayu, velamma yatzat karet baachoto – leduno becharet velo bemalkot.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ze – ikkar zedono bide adam, veze – ikkar zedono bide shamayim.

Amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: halacha kerabbi chananya ben gamliel. amar rav yosef: man selek leella vaata vaamar?! amar leh abbaye: ella ha deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shelosha devarim asu bet din shel matta vehiskimu bet din shel mala al yadam – man selek leella vaata vaamar? ella: kerae ka darshinan, hacha name, kerae ka darshinan.
Gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shelosha devarim asu bet din shel matta vehiskimu bet din shel mala al yadam, [ellu hen]: mikra megilla, usheelat shalom [bashshem], vahavaat maaser.
Mikra megilla – dichtiv "kiyyemu vekibbelu hayyehudim" – kiyyeymu lemala ma shekkibbelu lematta.

Usheelat shalom – dichtiv "vehinne voaz ba mibbet lechem vayyomer lakkotzrim Adonai immachem", veomer "Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil". may "veomer"? vechi tema boaz hu daavad middateh, umishshemayya la askimu al yedeh – ta shema: veomer "Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil".

Havaat maaser – dichtiv "haviu et kol hammaaser el bet haotzar vihi teref beveti uvechanuni na bazot amar Adonai tzevaot im lo eftach lachem et arubbot hashshamayim vaharikoti lachem beracha ad beli day". may "ad beli day"? amar rame bar rav: ad sheyyivlu siftotechem millomar "day".

Amar rabbi elazar: bishlosha mekomot hofia ruach hakkodesh: bevet dino shel shem, uvevet dino shel shemuel haramati, uvevet dino shel shelomo. bevet dino shel shem – dichtiv "vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadka mimmenni". mena yada? dilma ki hechi daazal ihu legabba azal name inash acharina [legabba]! yatzat bat kol veamra: mimmenni yatzu kevushim.

Bevet dino shel shemuel – dichtiv "hinni anu vi neged Adonai veneged meshicho et shor mi lakachti... vayyomru lo ashaktanu velo ratztzotanu... vayyomer ed Adonai veed meshicho... ki lo metzatem beyadi meuma vayyomer ed", "vayyomer"? "vayyomru" mibbee leh! yatzat bat kol veamra: ani ed bedavar ze.
Bevet dino shel shelomo – dichtiv "vayyaan hammelech vayyomer tenu lah et hayyeled hachay vehamet lo temituhu (ki) hi immo". mena yada? dilma iarume meyarma! yatzat bat kol veamra: "hi immo".
Amar rava: mimmay? dilma yehuda, kevan dechashshev yarche veyome veitremi – dechazenan machzekinan, dela chazenan la machzekinan.
Shemuel name, kullehu yisrael kare lehu bilshon yechidi, dichtiv "yisrael nosha baAdonai".
Shelomo name – middeha ka (merachamta) [merachama] veha la ka (merachamta) [merachama]! ella gemara.

Darash rabbi simlay: shesh meot ushelosh esre mitzvot neemru lo lemoshe, shelosh meot veshishshim vechamesh lavin keminyan yemot hachamma, umatayim vearbaim ushemona ase keneged evarav shel adam. amar rav hamenuna: may kera – "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha", "tora" begimatriyya

a: Shet mea vechad sere have, "anochi" velo yihye lecha" – mippi haggevura shemanum.
(Siman dameshamek sak).

Ba david veheemidan al achat esre, dichtiv "mizmor ledavid [Adonai] mi yagur beoholecha mi yishkon behar kodshecha. holech tamim ufoel tzedek vedover emet bilvavo, lo ragal al leshono lo asa lereehu raa vecherpa lo nasa al kerovo. nivze beenav nimas veet yire Adonai yechabbed nishba lehara velo yamir. kaspo lo natan beneshech veshochad al naki lo lakach ose elle lo yimmot leolam".
"Holech tamim" – ze avraham, dichtiv "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim".
"Poel tzedek" – kegon abba chilkiyyahu.
"Vedover emet bilvavo" – kegon rav safra.
"Lo ragal al leshono" – ze yaakov avinu, dichtiv "ulay yemushsheni avi vehayiti veenav kimtatea".
"Lo asa lereehu raa" – shello yarad leummanut chavero.
"Vecherpa lo nasa al kerovo" – ze hamekarev et kerovav.
"Nivze beenav nimas" – ze chizkiyyahu hammelech, sheggerar atzmot aviv bemitta shel chavalim.
"Veet yire Adonai yechabbed" – ze yehoshafat melech yehuda, shebbeshaa shehaya roe talmid chacham haya omed mikkisseo umechabbeko umenashsheko vekore lo "avi avi, rabbi rabbi, mari mari".
"Nishba lehara velo yamir" – kerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: ehe betaanit ad sheavo leveti.
"Kaspo lo natan beneshech" – afillu (b)ribbit goy.
"Veshochad al naki lo lakach" – kegon rabbi yishmael berabbi yose.
Ketiv "ose elle lo yimmot leolam" – keshehaya rabban gamliel maggia lemikra hazze haya boche, amar: man deaved lehu lechullehu – hu dela yimmot, ha chada minnayyhu – yimmot.

Amaru leh: mi ketiv "ose kol elle"? "ose elle" ketiv, afillu bachada minnayyhu. dei la tema hachi, ketiv kera acharina "al tittammeu bechol elle", hatam name, hannogea bechol elle – hu demittamme, bachada minnayyhu – la? ella lav beachat mikkol elle, hacha name beachat mikkol ellu.
Ba yeshayahu veheemidan al shesh, dichtiv "holech tzedakot vedover mesharim moes bevetza maashakkot noer kappav mittemoch bashshochad otem ozno mishshemoa damim veotzem enav merot bera".
"Holech tzedakot" – ze avraham avinu, dichtiv "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve vegomer".
"Vedover mesharim" – ze sheeno maknit pene chavero barabbim.
"Moes bevetza maashakkot" – kegon rabbi yishmael ben elisha.
"Noer kappav mittemoch bashshochad" – kegon rabbi yishmael berabbi yose.
"Otem ozno mishshemoa damim" – dela shama beziluta detzureba merabbanan veshatek, kegon rabbi elazar berabbi shimon.
"Veotzem enav merot bera" – kerabbi chiyyay bar abba, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ze sheeno mistakkel benashim beshaa sheomdot al hakkevisa.
Uchetiv: "hu meromim yishkon".
Ba micha veheemidan al shalosh, dichtiv "higgid lecha adam ma tov uma Adonai doresh mimmecha ki im asot mishpat veahavat chesed vehatzenea lechet im (Adonai) elohecha".

"Asot mishpat" – ze haddin. "ahavat chesed" – ze gemilut chasadim. "vehatzenea lechet" – ze hotzaat hammet vehachenasat kalla. vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma devarim sheen darkan laasotan betzina, amra tora "vehatzenea lechet", devarim sheddarkam laasotam betzina – al achat kamma vechamma!

Chazar yeshayahu veheemidan al shetayim, shenneemar "ko amar Adonai shimru mishpat vaasu tzedaka". ba amos veheemidan al achat, shenneemar "ko amar Adonai levet yisrael dirshuni vichyu". matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ema dirshuni bechol hattora! ella: ba chavakkuk veheemidan al achat, shenneemar "vetzaddik beemunato yichye".

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: arba gezerot gazar moshe rabbenu al yisrael, bau arbaa neviim uvittelum. moshe amar: "vayyishkon yisrael betach badad en yaakov", ba amos uvittelah, [shenneemar]: "chadal na mi yakum yaakov vegomer" uchetiv "nicham Adonai al zot".
Moshe amar: "uvaggoyim hahem lo targia", ba yirmeya veamar: "haloch leharegio yisrael".
Moshe amar: "poked avon avot al banim", ba yechezkel uvittelah: "hannefesh hachotet hi tamut".
Moshe amar "vaavadtem baggoyim", ba yeshayahu veamar: "vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol".

Amar rav: mistefena mehay kera "vaavadtem baggoyim". matkef la rav pappa: dilma kaaveda hammitbakkeshet, dichtiv "taiti kese oved bakkesh avdecha"! ella missefa [dikra], "veachla etchem eretz oyvechem". matkef la mar zutera: dilma kaachilat kishshuin vedilluin.

Uchevar haya rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva mehallechin badderech, veshamu kol hamonah shel romi mippelatah [berachok] mea veesrim mil, vehitchilu bochin, verabbi akiva mesachek. amru lo: mippene ma atta mesachek? amar lahem: veattem mippene ma attem bochim? amru lo: hallalu goyim shemmishtachavim laatzabbim umekatterim laavoda zara yoshvin betach vehasheket, veanu, bet hadom ragle elohenu saruf
b: Baesh, velo nivke?! amar lahen: lechach ani metzachek, uma leovre retzono kach, leose retzono al achat kamma vechamma.

Shuv paam achat hayu olin lirushalayim, kevan shehiggiu lehar hatztzofim karu bigdehem, kevan shehiggiu lehar habbayit rau shual sheyyatza mibbet kodshe hakkodashim, hitchilu hen bochin verabbi akiva metzachek. amru lo: mippene ma atta metzachek? amar lahem: mippene ma attem bochim? amru lo: makom shekkatuv bo "vehazzar hakkarev yumat", veachshav shualim hillechu bo, velo nivke?!

Amar lahen: lechach ani metzachek, dichtiv: "veaida li edim neemanim et uriyya hakkohen veet zecharya ben yeverechyahu" – vechi ma inyan uriyya etzel zecharya? uriyya bemikdash rishon, uzecharya bemikdash sheni! ella: tala hakkatuv nevuato shel zecharya binvuato shel uriyya.

Beuriyya ketiv "lachen biglalchem tziyyon sade techaresh", bizcharya ketiv "od yeshvu zekenim uzekenot birchovot yerushalam". ad shello nitkayyeyma nevuato shel uriyya hayiti mityayre shello titkayyem nevuato shel zecharya, achshav shennitkayyeyma nevuato shel uriyya – beyadua shennevuato shel zecharya mitkayyemet. ballashon hazze amru lo: akiva nichamtanu, akiva nichamtanu.
Hadaran alach ellu hen hallokin uselika la massechet makkot

a: Mishna shevuot – shetayim shehen arba.
Yediot hattumea – shetayim shehen arba.
Yetziot hashshabbat – shetayim shehen arba.
Marot negaim – shenayim shehen arbaa.
Et sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla vidia bassof vehelem benatayim – hare ze beole veyored.
Yesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof – sair hannaase bifnim veyom hakkippurim tole, ad sheyyivvada lo veyavi beole veyored.

En bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof – sair hannaase bachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper. shenneemar: "millevad chattat hakkippurim" – al ma shezze mechapper, ze mechapper; ma happenimi en mechapper ella al davar sheyyesh bah yedia, af hachitzon en mechapper ella al davar sheyyesh bah yedia.

Veal sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof – seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim mechapperin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: seire hargalim mechapperin, aval lo seire rashe chodashim. veal ma seire rashe chodashim mechapperin?
b: Al hattahor sheachal et hattame.
Rabbi meir omer: kol haseirin kapparatan shava, al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.

Haya rabbi shimon omer: seire rashe chodashim mechapperim al hattahor sheachal et hattame, veshel regalim mechapperin al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof, veshel yom hakkippurim mechapper al sheen bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof.
Amru lo: mahu sheyyikrevu ze baze? amar lahen: yikrevu. amru lo: hoil veen kapparatan shava, heach kerevin ze beze? amar lahem: kullan bain lechapper al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshemo: seire rashe chodashim – mechapperin al hattahor sheachal et hattame. mosif alehen shel regalim – shemmechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame, veal sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof.
Mosif alehen shel yom hakkippurim – shehen mechapperin al hattahor sheachal et hattame, veal sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof, veal sheen bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof.

Amru lo: mahu sheyyikrevu ze baze? amar lahem: hen. amru lo: im ken, yihyu shel yom hakkippurim kerevin berashe chodashim; aval heach shel rashe chodashim kerevin beyom hakkippurim – lechapper kappara sheenah shellah? amar lahem: kullan bain lechapper al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.
Veal zedon tumeat mikdash vekadashav – sair hannaase bifnim veyom hakkippurim mechapperin.
Al shear averot shebbattora; hakkallot vehachamurot, hazzedonot vehashshegagot, hoda velo hoda, ase velo taase, karetot umitot bet din – sair hammishtalleach mechapper.
Echad yisreelim veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach. ma ben yisreelim lechohanim ulechohen mashuach? ella shehappar mechapper al hakkohanim – al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.

Rabbi shimon omer: keshem sheddam hassair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael, kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim; keshem shevvidduyo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael, kach vidduyo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim.
Gemara mikkede tanna mimmakkot salek, may shena detane shevuot? mishshum detane: chayyayv al harosh shetayim – achat mikkan veachat mikkan,

a: Veal hazzakan shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan veachat millematta;
Chada demichayyayv ala tarte; tane shevuot shetayim shehen arba.
May shena hacha detane lehu lechullehu, umay shena gabbe yetziot shabbat umarot negaim, dela katane lehu lechullehu?
Amri: shevuot vidiot hattumea degabbe hadade ketivan, vedamyayn ahadade bekorban ole veyored – tane lehu gabbe hadade; veayyeyde ditna tarte – tena kullehu.
Petach bishvuot, umefaresh yediot hattumea! ayyeyde dezuteran millayyhu, pasek share lehu; vahadar tane shevuot dinfishan millayyhu.
Shevuot shetayim shehen arba: shetayim – "sheochal" veshello ochal"; shehen arba – "achalti" veshello achalti".
Yediot hattumea shetayim shehen arba: shetayim – yediat tumeat kodesh vidiat tumeat mikdash; shehen arba – kodesh umikdash.
Yetziot shabbat shetayim shehen arba: shetayim – hotzaa deani vehotzaa devaal habbayit; shehen arba – hachenasa deani vehachenasa devaal habbayit.
Marot negaim shenayim shehen arbaa: shenayim – seet uvaheret; shehen arbaa – seet vetoladtah, baheret vetoladtah.
Manni matnitin? lo rabbi yishmael vela rabbi akiva! i rabbi yishmael – haamar: eno chayyayv ella al heatid lavo. i rabbi akiva – haamar: al helem tumea hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem mikdash.
Ibbaet ema rabbi yishmael, ibbaet ema rabbi akiva. ibbaet ema rabbi yishmael – mehen lechiyyuv umehen liftur. veibbaet ema rabbi akiva – mehen lechiyyuv umehen liftur.
Liftur?!
b: Ha dumeya demarot negaim katane – ma hatam kullehu lechiyyuva, af hacha name kullehu lechiyyuva!
Leolam rabbi yishmael; vechi la mechayyev rabbi yishmael lesheavar – korban; aval malkot chayyove mechayyev.
Vechidrava – deamar rava: beferush ribbeta tora shevuat sheker dumeya dishvuat shav; ma shav lesheavar, af sheker name lesheavar.
Bishlama "achalti" velo achalti" – kidrava; "shello ochal" veachal name – lav sheyyesh bo maase hu; ella "ochal" velo achal – ammay? lav sheen bo maase hu!
Kasavar rabbi yishmael: lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav.
I hachi, kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan!
Deamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna;

Veittemar: "shevua sheochal kikkar zo hayyom", veavar hayyom velo achalah – rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: eno loke. rabbi yochanan amar eno loke – mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav. veresh lakish amar eno loke – hateraat safek hi, vehateraat safek lo shemah hateraa.
Rabbi yochanan setama acharina ashkach.
He setama? illema hay setama – ditnan: aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame – eno loke et haarbaim;
Bishlama shover battame, dichtiv "veetzem lo tishberu bo" – bechasher velo befasul. aval hammotir battahor, may tama? lav mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokim alav?
Umimmay derabbi yaakov hi – deamar lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav? dilma rabbi yehuda hi – umishshum deva hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase; ha lav hachi, lake!

Detanya: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker, vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu" – ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar sheen lokin alav; divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yaakov omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, velav sheen bo maase en lokim alav.
Ella hay setama ashkach: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo", "shevua shello ochlenna", vaachalah –

a: Eno chayyayv ella achat. zo hi shevuat bittuy, shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah korban ole veyored.
"Zo hi dechayyayvin al zedonah makkot" – aval "ochal" velo achal, la lake!
Mikkedi hay setama vehay setama; may chaze deaved ki hay setama? lebed ki hay setama!
Uletamaych – rabbi gufeh, hechi setam lan hacha hachi vehacha hachi?
Ella meikkara savar lav sheen bo maase lokin alav, vesatma, vahadar savar en lokin alav, vesatma; umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.

Bemay okemta – kerabbi yishmael, ulemalkot; marot negaim – may malkot ikka? bekotzetz bahareto, ucherabbi avin amar rabbi ila; deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer", "pen" veal" – eno ella lo taase.

Yetziot shabbat, may malkot ikka? lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din hu – vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din, en lokin alav! mishshum hachi ka mokemna kerabbi yishmael, deamar: lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din – lokin alav.
Ha lav hachi, kayyma kerabbi akiva?! kashya yediot! lav amrat: rabbi yishmael hi – ulemalkut? rabbi akiva name – ulemalkut.
I hachi, "yediot"?! "hateraot" mibbee leh! ha la kashya, teni "yediot dehatraot".
I hachi, "shetayim shehen arba"?! tarte hu dehavyayn! vetu, "et sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla vidia bassof vehelem benatayim" – haalama lemalkut may avidteh? vetu, "hare ze beole veyored"!
Ella amar rav yosef: rabbi hi, venasev la allibba detannae. bidiot – nasev la kerabbi yishmael, bishvuot – nasev la kerabbi akiva.
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana, veamar li: la tema rabbi nasev la allibba detannae – veleh la sevira leh;

Ella rabbi tameh denafsheh mefaresh, detanya: minnayin sheeno chayyayv ella al sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla vidia bassof vehelem benatayim? talmud lomar: "venelam" "venelam" shene peamim, divre rabbi akiva.
Rabbi omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer:
b: "Venelam" – mikkelal deyada, "vehu yada" – hare kan shete yediot. im ken, ma talmud lomar: "venelam" "venelam"? lechayyev al helem tumea veal helem mikdash.
Ashkechan bidiot deit leh tameh denafsheh, shevuot delet leh tameh denafsheh menalan? sevara hu.
Lishshana acharina: ashkechan bidiot desavar la kerabbi yishmael, bishvuot desavar la kerabbi akiva menalan? sevara hu,
Rabbi akiva may tama ka mechayyev lesheavar – dedaresh ribbuye umiute; rabbi name daresh ribbuye umiute.
Detanya, rabbi omer: bakkol podin bechor adam, chutz min hashshetarot. verabbanan amri: bakkol podin bechor adam, chutz meavadim ushetarot vekarkaot.
May tama derabbi? daresh ribbuye umiute: "ufeduyav mibben chodesh" – ribba, "beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim" – miet, "tifde" – chazar veribba.
Ribba umiet veribba – ribba hakkol; may ribba – kol mille, umay miet – miet shetarot.
Verabbanan darshi kelale uferate: "ufeduyav mibben chodesh" – kalal, "beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim" – parat, "tifde" – chazar vechalal.

Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon. yatzu karkaot – sheenan mittaltelin; yatzu avadim – shehukkeshu lekarkaot; yatzu shetarot – af al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon.
Amar leh ravina leammemar: rabbi daresh ribbuye umiute?! veha rabbi kelale uferate daresh!

Detanya: "martzea" – en li ella martzea, minnayin lerabbot hassol vehassira, hammachat vehammakdeach vehammachtev? talmud lomar: "velakachta" – kol davar shennilkach bayyad, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. rabbi omer: "martzea" – ma martzea meyuchad, shel mattechet; af kol shel mattechet.
Veamrinan: bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi daresh kelale uferate, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda daresh

a: Ribbuye umiute.
In, bealma kelale uferate daresh; vehacha hayeynu tama – kidtana deve rabbi yishmael.
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: "bemayim" "bammayim" shene peamim – en ze kelal uferat, ella ribba umiet.
Verabbanan – amar ravina, kidamri bemareva: kol makom sheatta motze shete chelalot hassemuchot ze laze, hattel perat benehen, vedunem bichlal uferat.
Hasheta deamrat rabbi kelale uferate daresh, beal kurechech kashya shavuot! ella bishvuot nasev allibba derabbi akiva, veleh la sevira leh.
Gufa – minnayin sheeno chayyayv ella al sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla vidia bassof vehelem benatayim? talmud lomar: "venelam" "venelam" shene peamim. divre rabbi akiva.
Rabbi omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "venelam" – mikkelal sheyyada, "vehu yada" – hare kan shete yediot. im ken, ma talmud lomar: "venelam"? lechayyev al helem tumea veal helem mikdash.
Amar mar: "venelam" – mikkelal sheyyada. may mashma? amar rava: middela ketiv "vehi aluma mimmennu".
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, gabbe sota dichtiv: "venelam meene ishah" – mikkelal dehave yada meikkara?! i hava yada, mi badku la mayya?
Veha tanya: "venikka haish meavon vehaishsha hahiv tissa et avonah" – bizman shehaish menukke meavon, hammayim bodkin et ishto; en haish menukke meavon, en hammayim bodkin et ishto!
Vetu, gabbe tora dichtiv: "veneelma meene chol chay umeof hashshamayim nistara" – mikkelal deikka dahava yada beh? vehachtiv: "lo yada enosh erkah"!
Ella amar abbaye: kasavar rabbi, yediat bet rabbo shemah yedia.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ella dekatane "en bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof" – mi ikka delet leh yediat bet rabbo? amar leh: in, mashkachat la betinok shennishba leven haggoyim.

Yetziot shabbat shetayim shehen arba. tenan hatam: yetziot shabbat – shetayim shehen arba bifnim, ushetayim shehen arba bachutz. may shena hacha ditna "shetayim shehen arba" vetu la, umay shena hatam detane "shetayim shehen arba bifnim ushetayim shehen arba bachutz"?
Hatam deikkar shabbat hu, tane avot vetoladot. hacha delav ikkar shabbat hu – avot tane, vetoladot la tane.
Avot may ninhu – yetziot; yetziot tarte havyayn!
Vechi tema: mehen lechiyyuv umehen liftur; veha dumeya demarot negaim katane – ma hatam kullehu lechiyyuva, af hacha kullehu lechiyyuva!
Ella amar rav pappa: hatam deikkar shabbat, tane chiyyuve ufeture; hacha, chiyyuve tane ufeture la tane.
Chiyyuve may ninhu – yetziot; yetziot tarte hu dehavyayn! shetayim dehotzaa ushetayim dehachnasa.
Veha "yetziot" katane! amar rav ashe: tanna, hachenasa name "hotzaa" kare la. mimmay?
b: Ditnan: hammotzi mershut lirshut chayyayv. mi la askinan deka meayyel ayyole – veka kare leh "hotzaa"?
Vedilma ka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim? im ken, nitne "hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim"; may "mershut lirshut"? daafillu mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid,
Veka kare la "hotzaa". vetama may? tanna, kol akirat chefetz mimmekomo – "hotzaa" kare la.
Amar ravina: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: "yetziot shabbat shetayim shehen arba bifnim ushetayim shehen arba bachutz", veka mefaresh hachenasa. shema minna.
Rava amar: reshuyot katane – reshuyot shabbat shetayim.
Marot negaim shenayim shehen arbaa. tenan hatam: marot negaim – shenayim shehen arbaa: baheret – azza kashsheleg, sheniyya lah – kesid hahechol,
Seet – ketzemer lavan, sheniyya lah – kikrum betza.
Amar rabbi chanina: man tanna marot negaim? dela kerabbi akiva. dei rabbi akiva, kevan deamar: zo lemala mizzo vezo lemala mizzo, im ken tiharta sid hechol milletzaref.
Bahade man litzarfeh? litzarfeh bahade baheret – ikka seet daadifa minneh. litzarfeh bahade seet – lav tolada dideh hu.
I hachi, kerum betza name – bahade man litzarfeh? litzarfeh bahade seet – ikka sid daadif minneh, litzarfeh bahade sid – lav bar mineh hu!

a: Hay may? bishlama bela sid hechol, kerum betza la kashya – deaf al gav dikrum betza mittattay diset, rachamana amar "velaset velassappachat" – sappachat tefela lasseet, af al gav deminnachata minnay tuva. ella sid hechol – kashya, ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi akiva.
Vehecha shaminan lerabbi akiva zo lemala mizzo?

Illema meha – detanya: amar rabbi yose, shaal yehoshua beno shel rabbi akiva merabbi akiva: mippene ma amru marot negaim shenayim shehen arbaa? amar lo: veim lav, ma yomru? yomru mikkerum betza ulemala tame!
Amar lo: lomar shemmitztarfim ze im ze. amar lo, veyomru: "mikkerum betza ulemala tame, umitztarfin ze im ze"! amar lo: lomar lach, kol kohen sheeno baki bahen uvishmotehen, eno roe et hannegaim.
Veillu "missid hechol ulemala" – la kaamar;
Middela amar leh, shema minna dishmia leh lerabbi akiva deamar: kullehu levahade seet mitztarfin.
Vedilma "seet vetoladtah", "baheret vetoladtah"?

Ella midderabbi chanina – deamar rabbi chanina: mashal derabbi akiva lema haddavar dome? learbaa kosot shel chalav, echad naflu letocho shete tippin shel dam, veechad naflu letocho arba tippin shel dam, veechad naflu letocho shemone, veechad naflu letocho shetem esre tippin – veamri la: shesh esre tippin – shekkullan marot loven hen, ella shezze lemala mizze veze lemala mizze.
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi akiva – befatuch; bechaluk mi shamat leh?

Vechi tema ki hechi deshamat leh befatuch, hachi shamat leh bechaluk; uvefatuch gufeh mi shamat leh? vehatanya, rabbi akiva omer: adamdam shebbaze veshebbaze keyayin hammazug bemayim; ella shel baheret azza kashsheleg, veshel sid deha hemenna.
b: Veim ita, "shel tzemer deha hemenna" mibbee leh!
Amri: in hachi name, vehatanya: rabbi natan omer, lo sheamar rabbi akiva "shel sid deha hemenna", ella "shel tzemer deha hemenna".
Umenalan devaheret azza hi? amar abbaye, amar kera: "im baheret levana hi" – hi levana, veen acheret levana.

Tanu rabbanan: "baheret" – amukka, vechen hu omer: "umareha amok min haor"; kemare chamma haamukka min hatztzel. "seet" – en seet ella gavoah, vechen hu omer: "al kol heharim haramim veal kol haggevaot hannissaot". "sappachat" – en sappachat ella tefela, vechen hu omer: "veamar sefacheni na".

Ashkechan tefela lasseet; tefela labbaheret menalan? amar rabbi zera: neemra "levana" basseet, veneemra "levana" babbaheret; ma levana haamura basseet – yesh lah tefela, af levana haamura babbaheret – yesh lah tefela.
Bematnita tana: hetil hakkatuv lassappachat ben seet labbaheret, lomar lach: keshem shettefela lasseet, kach tefela labbaheret.
Seet ketzemer lavan. may "tzemer lavan"? amar rav bivi amar rav assi: tzemer naki ben yomo, shemchabbenin bo lemelat.
Amar rabbi chanina: mashal derabbanan – lema haddavar dome? litre malche velitre ipparche; malko shel ze lemala mimmalko shel ze, veipparcho shel ze lemala meipparcho shel ze.
Hay ze lemala mizze veze lemala mizze hu!
Ella malko shel ze lemala meipparcheh denafsheh, umalko shel ze lemala meipparcheh denafsheh.
Rav adda bar abba amar: kegon malka vealkafta, rufila veresh galuta. hay ze lemala mizze hu! ella kegon malka verufila, vealkafta veresh galuta.
Rava amar: kegon shabbur malka vekesar.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: he minnayyhu adif? amar leh: bechureshayya ka achel leh. pok chazi tiva deman saggi bealma – dichtiv: "vetechul kol ara utedushinna vetaddekinna". amar rabbi yochanan: zo romi chayyevet, shettivah yatza bechol haolam kullo.
Ravina amar: kegon gelima daamar veshachkeh, sedina dechittana veshachkeh.
Et sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla vechulei. tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen hakkatuv medabber ella betumeat mikdash vekadashav?

Vedin hu – hoil vehizhir veanash al hattumea, vechayyayv korban al hattumea; ma keshehizhir veanash al hattumea – lo hizhir veanash ella al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, af keshechiyyev korban al hattumea – lo chiyyev ella al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.
Veema teruma – shehizhir veanash! la ashkechan avon mita dechayyayv aleha korban.
Ema: hane mille korban kavua, aval

a: Ole veyored nayte – midde dehave ashshemiat kol veabbittuy sefatayim!
Amar kera: "bah"; "bah" – lemaote teruma.
Ema: "bah" – lemaote mikdash; dela saggi leh bekorban ole veyored ad demayyte korban kavua!
Kare rava aleh derabbi: dole mayim mibborot amukkim.
Detanya, rabbi omer: ekra ani "chayya"; "behema" lamma neemra? neemar kan "behema temea", veneemar lehallan "behema temea"; ma lehallan tumeat kodesh, af kan tumeat kodesh.
Ashkechan tumeat kodesh, tumeat mikdash menalan? amar kera: "bechol kodesh lo tigga veel hammikdash lo tavo" – ittakkash mikdash lekodesh.
I hachi, teruma name – deamar mar: "bechol kodesh lo tigga" – lerabbot et hatteruma!
Ha miet rachamana "bah". ema "bah" – lemaote mikdash! mistabbera mikdash la memaatinan, shekken becharet kemotah.
Adderabba, teruma la memaatinan – shekken achila kemotah!
Ella amar rava: shalosh karetot bishlamim lamma? achat lichlal, veachat lifrat, veachat letumea hakketuva battora setam. veeni yodea ma hi,
Heve omer: tumeat kodesh. veim eno inyan letumeat kodesh – denafka leh midderabbi, tenehu inyan letumeat mikdash.
Vehay mibbee leh lechidrabbi avahu! deamar rabbi avahu: shalosh karetot bishlamim lamma? achat lichlal, veachat lifrat, veachat lidvarim sheenan neechalin.

Ulerabbi shimon deamar: devarim sheenan neechalin en chayyayvin alehen karet mishshum tumea; leetoye chattat happenimit. desalka datach amena, hoil veamar rabbi shimon: kol sheeno karev al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, mishshum tumea name la; ka mashma lan demichayyayv.
Ella amri nehardae mishshemeh derava: shalosh tumeot bishlamim lamma? achat lichlal, veachat lifrat, veachat letumea hakketuva betora setam. veeni yodea ma hi,
Heve omer tumeat kodesh; veim eno inyan letumeat kodesh – denafka leh midderabbi, tenehu inyan letumeat mikdash.
Vehay name mibbee leh – ayyeyde devae lemichtav karet lechidrabbi avahu, ketav name temaot, dela saggi la belav hachi!
Ella amar rava: atya "tumeato"–"tumeato"; ketiv hacha: "lechol tumeato",
b: Uchetiv hatam: "tame yihye od tumato bo"; ma lehallan tumeat mikdash, af kan tumeat mikdash.
Veella "bah" lema li?
Lerabbot nivlat of tahor.
Ha amrat: "bah" miuta hu! mishshum demiuta hu – iyyaytar; ketiv: "o ki yigga" – devar negia in delav bar negia la, uchetiv "bah" – miuta; have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot.
Yesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof – sair hannaase bifnim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael vegomer" –
Yesh li beinyan ze lehavi shalosh tevmaot: tumeat avoda zara, vetumeat gilluy arayot, vetumeat shefichut damim.

Baavoda zara hu omer: "lemaan tamme et mikdashi"; begilluy arayot hu omer: "ushemartem et mishmarti levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot vegomer velo tittammeu bahem"; bishfichut damim hu omer: "velo tetamme et haaretz". yachol al shalosh tevmaot hallalu yehe sair mechapper? talmud lomar: "mittumot bene yisrael" – velo kol tumeot.
Ma matzinu shechillek hakkatuv mikkelal kol tumeot – heve omer tumeat mikdash vekadashav; af kan – betumeat mikdash vekadashav. divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: mimmekomo hu muchera; hare hu omer: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot" – mittumeot shel kodesh.
Yachol al kol tumea shebbakkodesh yehe sair ze mechapper? talmud lomar: "umippishehem lechol chattotam" – chataim dumeya difshaim; ma peshaim sheenam bene korban, af chataim sheenam bene korban.
Uminnayin leyesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof, shessair ze tole? talmud lomar: "lechol chattotam" – chayyayve chattaot bammashma.
Amar mar: yesh li beinyan ze lehavi shalosh tumeot – tumeat avoda zara, vetumeat gilluy arayot, vetumeat shefichut damim.
Hay avoda zara, hechi dame? i bemezid – bar ketala hu! i beshogeg – bar korban hu!
Bemezid – vela atro beh, beshogeg – vela ityeyda leh.

a: Gilluy arayot name, hechi dame? i bemezid – bar ketala hu! i beshogeg – bar korban hu!
Bemezid – vela atro beh, beshogeg – vela ityeda leh.
Shefichut damim name, hechi dame? i bemezid – bar ketala hu! i beshogeg – bar galut hu!
Bemezid – vela atro beh, beshogeg – vela ityeda leh. i name, behanach delav bene galut ninhu.

Amar mar: yachol al shalosh tevmaot hallalu yehe sair mechapper? talmud lomar: "mittumot" – velo kol tumeot; ma matzinu shechalak hakkatuv mikkelal kol hattevmaot – betumeat mikdash vekadashav; af kan – betumeat mikdash vekadashav. divre rabbi yehuda.
May chalak? demayyte beole veyored. ema avoda zara, umay chalak –
(Siman: avoda zara, yoledet, metzora, nazir vechulei)
Demayyte seira velo kisba!
Amar rav kahana: anan chalak lehakel kaamrinan, vehay chalak lehachemir hu.
Ema yoledet – dechalak, demayyta ole veyored! amar rav hoshaya: "lechol chattotam" – velo lechol tumeotam.
Ulerabbi shimon ben yochay deamar yoledet name chotet hi, may ikka lememar? rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: mimmekomo hu muchera.
Ema metzora! amar rav hoshaya: "lechol chattotam" – velo lechol tumeotam.
Ulerabbi shemuel bar nachmani, deamar: al shiva devarim negaim bain – may ikka lememar? hatam nigeh deikkappar leh, vekorban leishteroye bakkahal.
Veema nazir tame – dechalak, demayyte torim uvene yona! amar rav hoshaya: "lechol chattotam" – velo lechol tumeotam.
Ulerabbi elazar hakkappar, deamar nazir name chote hu, may ikka lememar? savar la kerabbi shimon, deamar: mimmekomo hu muchera.

Amar mar, rabbi shimon omer: mimmekomo hu muchera; hare hu omer: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot" – mittumeato shel kodesh kulei. shappir kaamar rabbi shimon! verabbi yehuda amar lach: hahu mibbee leh – ki hechi deaved lifnay velifnim, hachi naaved bahechol.
Verabbi shimon – hahu mivvechen yaase" nafka. verabbi yehuda – i mehahi, hava amena nayte par vesair acharine venaaved; ka mashma lan. verabbi shimon, "vechen yaase leohel moed" – minneh mashma.

Amar mar: yachol al kol tumeot shebbakkodesh yehe sair ze mechapper? talmud lomar: "mippishehem lechol chattotam vegomer". may nihu – yesh bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof; hay bar korban hu!
La tzericha, deityeda leh samuch lishkiat hachamma. salka datach amena: addemayyte
b: Nitle leh, ka mashma lan.
Amar mar: minnayin sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof shessair ze tole? minnayin?! may ka kashya leh?

Hachi ka kashya leh: hasheta deamrat chataim dumeya difshaim – ma peshaim delav bene korban, af chattaim name delav bene korban; ema: ma peshaim delav bene korban leolam, af chattaim delav bene korban leolam; umay ninhu – in bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof; aval yesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof, kevan dechi mityeda leh bar korban hu – ema la litle!
Vechi tema: en bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof – sair hannaase bachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper;
Salka datach amena nefoch mefach, amar kera "lechol chattotam" – mikkelal divne chattaot ninhu.
Venitkappar [unechappar] kappara gemura! i ketiv "mechattotam" – kidka amrat, hasheta dichtiv "lechol chattotam" – lehanach deatu lichlal chattat.
Vechi meachar sheeno mechapper, lamma tole? amar rabbi zera: lomar sheim met – met belo avon. amar leh rava: im met – mita memareket! ella amar rava: lehagen alav min hayyissurin.
En bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof – sair hannaase bachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper kulei.
Mikkede ittakkoshe ittakkush lahadade, unechappar penimi addideh veaddechitzon – venafka minna lehecha dela avad chitzon! amar kera: "achat" – kappara achat mechapper, veeno mechapper shete kapparot.
Unechappar chitzon addideh, veammay deaved penimi – nafka minna letumea deera ben ze leze! amar kera: "achat bashshana" – kappara zo lo tehe

a: Ella achat bashshana.
Ulerabbi yishmael deamar en bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof bar korban hu, sair hannaase bachutz ammay mechapper? al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof.
Hay seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim mechapperin! savar la kerabbi meir, deamar: kol hasseirim kapparatan shava – al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.
Ella lemay hilcheta ittakkash chitzon lifnimi? ma penimi eno mechapper bishar averot, af chitzon eno mechapper bishar averot.
Al sheen bah yedia battechilla velo bassof, seire regalim useire rashe chodashim mechapperin. divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: may tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "useir izzim echad lechattat laAdonai" – chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai, yehe sair ze mechapper.
Vehay mibbee leh lechidresh lakish – deamar resh lakish: ma nishtanna sair shel rosh chodesh shenneemar bo "laAdonai"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: sair ze yehe kappara al shemmiatti et hayyareach.
Im ken, lema kera "al Adonai"; may "laAdonai"? lichdaamaran.
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata! im ken, nema kera: "chattat Adonai"; may "laAdonai"? shamat minna tarte.

Unechappar name afillu bishar averot! tana deve rabbi yishmael: hoil veze ba bizman kavua veze ba bizman kavua; ma ze eno mechapper ella al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, af ze eno mechapper ella al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.

Ashkechan seire rashe chodashim, seire hargalim menalan? vechi tema ha name kidtana deve rabbi yishmael, ikka lemifrach: i midderosh chodesh – shekken tadir, i middeyom hakkippurim – shekken merubba kapparato! vechi tema
b: Ha gamrinan rosh chodesh middeyom hakkippurim vela parchinan; hatam – kappara michtav ketiva, galloye milleta bealma hu; aval hacha – ikka lememar kulla milleta la gamrinan!

Ella kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: "seir"–"useir"; hacha name "seir"–"useir", veittakkush seire regalim lisire rashe chodashim; ma seire rashe chodashim enan mechapperin ella al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof, af seire hargalim enan mechapperin ella al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof.

Ibbaya lehu: ki amar rabbi yehuda al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof – hane mille bechet sheen sofo livvada, aval chet shessofo livvada – kemi sheyyesh yedia bassof dame, vesair hannaase bachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper; o dilma afillu chet shessofo livvada – hasheta miha, chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai karena beh?
Ta shema, detanya: al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof, vechet shessofo livvada – seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim mechapperim. divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: seire hargalim mechapperin, aval lo seire rashe chodashim vechulei.

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: may tameh derabbi shimon? amar kera: "veotah natan lachem laset et avon haeda", vehay kera besair derosh chodesh ketiv; veyalef "avon"–"avon" mitztzitz – neemar kan "avon", veneemar lehallan "avon"; ma lehallan tumeat basar, af kan tumeat basar.
I ma lehallan olin, af kan olin?! "avon haeda" ketiv.
Mikkede migmar gamri mehadade; nechappar derosh chodesh addideh veaddetzitz – nafka minna lehecha denishbar hatztzitz! amar kera: "avon" – avon echad hu nose, veen nose shene avonot.
Unechappar tzitz addideh veadderosh chodesh – nafka minna letumea deera ben ze leze! amar kera: "otah" – otah nose avon, veen acheret nose avon.
Rav ashe amar: ketiv hacha "avon haeda" – eda velo kadashim, vehatam ketiv "avon hakkodashim" – kadashim velo eda.
Ashkechan seire rashe chodashim dimchapperi al tahor sheachal et hattame; seire regalim dimchapperi al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof – menalan?
Kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: "seir"–"useir", hacha name "seir"–"useir",

a: Veittakkush seire hargalim lisire rashe chodashim; ma sair derosh chodesh bemilleta dekodesh mechapperi, af seire regalim bemilleta dekodesh mechapperi.
Vechi tema nichapperu adderosh chodesh – ha amrinan: "otah" – otah nose avon, veen acher nose avon.
Vechi tema nichapperu addeyom hakkippurim – ha amrinan: "achat bashshana" – kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana.
Ammay mechapperi?

I al sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof – hay bar korban hu! i al sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof – hay sair hannaase bifnim veyom hakkippurim tole! i al sheen bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof – hay sair hannaase bachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper!
Al korchach, eno mechapper ella al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof.
Rabbi meir omer: kol hasseirim kapparatan shava kulei.
Amar rabbi chama bar rabbi chanina: may tama derabbi meir? amar kera "seir"–"useir", hukkeshu kol hasseirim ze laze – vav mosif al inyan rishon.
Kasalka datach kol chad vechad mechavreh gamar?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: kol hattora kullah lemedin lamed millamed, chutz mikkodashim sheen lemedin lamed millamed!
Ha la kashya, kullehu mikkamma gamri.
Tinach kol dichtiv beh "useir", atzeret veyom hakkippurim dela ketiv beh "useir" – menalan?
Ella amar rabbi yona, amar kera: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem" – hukkeshu kol hammoadim kullan ze laze. veha rosh chodesh lav moed hu!
Ivra, rosh chodesh name ikkeri moed, kidamar abbaye – deamar abbaye: tammuz dehahi shatta malloye malleyuho, dichtiv: "kara alay moed lishbor bachuray".
Amar rabbi yochanan: umode rabbi meir besair hannaase bifnim, shehu eno mechapper kapparatan, vehen enan mechapperin kapparato.
Hu eno mechapper kapparatan – kappara achat mechapper, veeno mechapper shete kapparot. hen enan mechapperin kapparato – amar kera "achat bashshana", kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana.

Tanya name hachi: al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof, veal sheen bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof, veal tahor sheachal et hattame – seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim vesair hannaase bachutz mechapperin. divre rabbi meir.
Veillu sair hannaase bifnim shayyeyre, (vakeparetan) [vechapparato] name shayyeyra.
Haya rabbi shimon omer: seire rashe chodashim mechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame kulei.

Bishlama derashe chodashim la mechapperi addirgalim, deamar kera: "avon" – avon echad hu nose, veeno nose shene avonot. ella dirgalim nichapperu adderashe chodashim! amar kera: "otah" – otah nose avon, veen acher nose avon.

Bishlama dirgalim la mechapperin addeyom hakkippurim, deamar kera "achat bashshana" – kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana. ella deyom hakkippurim nichapperu addirgalim! amar kera "achat" – kappara achat mechapper, veeno mechapper shete kapparot.
Veha ki ketiv "achat" – besair hannaase bifnim hu dichtiv! amar kera: "millevad
b: Chattat hakkippurim", veittakkush chitzon lifnimi.
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshemo kulei.

May shena derashe chodashim dela mechapperi addirgalim – deamar kera "avon", avon echad hu nose veeno nose shene avonot; dirgalim name la nichapperu adderashe chodashim – deamar kera "otah", otah hu nose avon veen acher nose avon! "otah" lo mashma leh.

May shena dirgalim dela mechapperi addeyom hakkippurim – deamar kera "achat bashshana", kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana; i hachi, deyom hakkippurim name la nichapperu addirgalim – "achat" ketiv, kappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shete kapparot! "achat" la mashma leh.
Ammay? dechi ketiv "achat" – besair hannaase bifnim ketiv. i hachi, dirgalim name nechapperu addeyom hakkippurim, dechi ketiv "achat" – besair hannaase bifnim ketiv!

Leolam "achat" mashma leh; veshane hacha, deamar kera: "vechipper aharon al karnotav achat bashshana" – karnotav demizbeach happenimi hu dechappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shete kapparot, ha dechitzon afillu shete kapparot.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: temidin shello hutzerchu latztzibbur, nifdin temimim.
Yatev rabba vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh rav chisda: man tzayet lach ulerabbi yochanan rabbach? vechi kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha?

Amar leh: at la tisbera dela amrinan "kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha"?! vehatnan: motar hakketoret, ma hayu osin bah? mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin, umechallelin otah al meot haummanin, venotnin otah laummanin bischaran, vechozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha.
Veammay? nema: "kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha"!
Amar leh: ketoret kaamrat? shane ketoret,

a: Dikdushshat damim hu.
Ella meatta, lo tippasel bitvul yom! allema tanya: netanah bemachteshet – nifselet bitvul yom?
Vechi tema kol kedushshat damim mippasli bitvul yom; vehatnan: hammenachot, moalin bahen mishshehukedshu; kadshu bichli – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina.
Kadshu bichli in, lo kadshu bichli la!

Ella may – kedushshat hagguf hi?! ella meatta, tippasel belina! allema tenan: hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashuach uminchat nesachim – moalim bahen mishshehukedshu, kadshu bichli – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina.
Kadshu bichli – in, lo kadshu bichli – la.
Amar leh: lina kaamrat? shane ketoret, hoil vetzuratah bechol hashshana kullah.
Mikkol makom kashya: vechi kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha? amar rabba: lev bet din matne alehen; im hutzerchu hutzerchu, veim lav yihyu lidmehen.
Amar leh abbaye, veha mar hu deamar: hikdish zachar ledamav – kadosh kedushshat hagguf! la kashya; ha deamar "lidme ola", ha deamar "lidme nesachim".
Etiveh abbaye: par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem,
b: Vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen – kullan yamutu. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. sheen chattat tzibbur meta.
Veammay? lema lev bet din matne alehen!
Avudin kaamrat? shane avudin, dela shechichi.

Hare para, dela shechicha, vetanya: para nifdet al kol pesul shebbah – meta tippade, nishchata tippade, matza acheret naa hemenna tippade. shechatah al gabbe maarachtah – en lah pediyyay olamit! shane para, dekodshe bedek habbayit hi.

I hachi, meta o nishchata tippade?! ha baenan haamada vehaaracha! ha manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kodshe mizbeach hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe bedek habbayit la hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha.
I rabbi shimon, ema sefa: shechatah al gabbe maarachtah, en lah pediyyay olamit.
Vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: para metammea tumeat ovchalin, hoil vehayta lah sheat hakkosher; veamar resh lakish: omer haya rabbi shimon, para nifdet al gav maarachtah!
Ella shane para, hoil vedameha yekarin.
Amar mar: meta tippade. vechi podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim?! amar rav mesharsheya: mishshum orah. vekayymi bet din umatnu addata deorah?! amar rav kahana, amri inashe: miggamla unna.
Etiveh: amru lo lerabbi shimon, mahu sheyyikrevu ze baze? amar lehu: yikrevu. amru lo: hoil veen kapparatan shava, heach hen kerevin? amar lahen: kullan bain lechapper al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.

Veammay? lema lev bet din matne alehen! rabbi shimon kaamrat? rabbi shimon let leh lev bet din matne alehen. deamar rav idi bar avin, amar rav amram, amar rabbi yochanan: temidin shello hutzerchu latztzibbur, ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin temimim, ledivre chachamim nifdin temimim.
Verabbanan difligi aleh derabbi shimon – man ninhu? i nema rabbanan diktoret –

a: Shane ketoret dela bar reiyya hi!
Ella rabbanan defara – dilma shane para dedameha yekarin!
Veella rabbanan deamru lo" –
Mimmay derabbi yehuda hi – vehachi kaamar leh: bishlama ledidi deamena lev bet din matne alehen – ammetu lehachi yikrevu; ella ledidach deamrat la – ammay yikrevu?
Vedilma rabbi meir hi – vehachi kaamar leh: bishlama ledidi, deamena kol hasseirim kapparatan shava – mishshum hachi yikrevu; ella ledidach, ammay yikrevu?
Ella rabbi yochanan gemara gemir la: ledivre rabbi shimon – en nifdin, ledivre chachamim – nifdin.
Ulerabbi shimon delet leh lev bet din matne alehen, may avdin lehu? amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: mekayyetzin bahen et hammizbeach.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: umode rabbi shimon bisire chattat, sheen mekayyetzin begufan ella bidmehen.
Hacha hu demeikkara ola vehasheta ola; aval hatam demeikkara chattat vehasheta ola – gezera leachar kappara attu lifne chappara.

Amar abbaye: af anan name tenena: par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem, vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen – kullan yamutu. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava; sheen chattat tzibbur meta.
Veammay? nikrevu inhu gufayyhu ola! ella lav shema minna: gezera leachar kappara attu lifne chappara?
Amar rava, af anan name tenena: vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava.
Veammay? yikrav ihu gufeh ola! ella lav shema minna: gezera achar kappara attu lifne chappara?

Amar ravina, af anan name tenena: asham shemmetu bealav o shennitkapperu bealav – yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer: yamut. rabbi yehoshua omer: yavi bedamav ola.
Velikrav ha gufa ola! ella lav gezera leachar kappara attu lifne kappara? shema minna.
Tanya name hachi: ma hen meviin min hammotarot?
b: Kayitz kivnot shuach lammizbeach. vehachtiv: "ki chol seor vechol devash vegomer"! tane rav chanina: kivnot shuach leadam.

Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: en mekayyetzin beolat haof. amar rava: ha burecha! amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: may burechta? ana amrita nihaleh, umishshemeh derav shimi minnehardea amrita nihaleh – deamar rav shimi minnehardea: motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli, veen olat of betzibbur.
Veaf shemuel savar leha derabbi yochanan, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: korbenot tzibbur – sakkin moshachtan lema shehen.

Tanya name hachi: umode rabbi shimon besair, sheim lo karav baregel yikrav berosh chodesh, veim lo karav berosh chodesh yikrav beyom hakkippurim, veim lo karav beyom hakkippurim yikrav baregel, veim lo karav beregel ze yikrav beregel acher; shemmittechillato lo ba ella lechapper al mizbeach hachitzon.
Tana: lo hukedash ella lechapper al mizbeach hachitzon.
Veal zedon tumeat mikdash vekadashav, sair hannaase bifnim kulei. menahane mille?

Detanu rabbanan: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael vegomer"; peshaim – ellu hammeradim, vechen hu omer: "melech moav pasha bi", veomer: "az tifsha livna baet hahi". chattaot – ellu hashshegagot, vechen hu omer: "nefesh ki techeta vishgaga".
Al shear averot shebbetora, hakkallot vehachamurot, hazzedonot vehashshegagot kulei.
Hayeynu kallot hayeynu ase velo taase! chamurot – hayeynu karetot umitot bet din! hoda – hayeynu mezid! lo hoda – hayeynu shogeg!

Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: al shear averot shebbattora – ben kallot ben chamurot, ben sheasaan beshogeg ben sheasaan bemezid. otan sheasaan beshogeg – ben noda lo sefekan, ben lo noda lo sefekan. veellu hen kallot – ase velo taase, veellu hen chamurot – karetot umitot bet din.
Hay ase hechi dame? i dela avad teshuva – "zevach reshaim toeva"! i daavad teshuva – kol yoma name, detanya: avar al mitzvat ase veasa teshuva, la zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo!
Amar rabbi zera:

a: Beomed bemirdo, verabbi hi. detanya: rabbi omer, al kol averot shebbattora, ben asa teshuva ben lo asa teshuva – yom hakkippurim mechapper; chutz mipporek ol umegalle panim battora umefer berit bevasar – sheim asa teshuva, yom hakkippurim mechapper; veim lav, en yom hakkippurim mechapper.

May tama derabbi? detanya: "ki devar Adonai baza" – ze happorek ol umegalle panim battora. "veet mitzvato hefer" – ze hammefer berit babbasar. "hikkaret tikkaret" – hikkaret lifne yom hakkippurim, tikkaret leachar yom hakkippurim.
Yachol afillu asa teshuva? talmud lomar: "avonah bah" – lo amarti ella bizman sheavonah bah.
Verabbanan – "hikkaret" baolam hazze, "tikkaret" laolam habba, "avonah bah" – sheim asa teshuva vamet, mita memareket.

Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi?! veha middesefa rabbi yehuda hi, resha name rabbi yehuda hi! dekatane sefa: echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach; uman it leh hay sevara – rabbi yehuda; mikkelal deresha rabbi yehuda.
Amar rav yosef: rabbi hi, vesavar la kerabbi yehuda.

Amar leh abbaye: davka kaamar mar – rabbi savar la kerabbi yehuda, aval rabbi yehuda la savar la kerabbi? o dilma, midderabbi savar la kerabbi yehuda, af rabbi yehuda savar la name kerabbi; mihu orcha demilleta katane – lememar detalmid savar la kerabbeh?
Amar leh: in, davka kaamena – rabbi savar la kerabbi yehuda, aval rabbi yehuda la savar la kerabbi.

Detanya: yachol yehe yom hakkippurim mechapper al shavim veal sheenan shavim? vedin hu – hoil vechattat veasham mechapperin, veyom hakkippurim mechapper; ma chattat veasham – en mechapperin ella al hashshavim, af yom hakkippurim – en mechapper ella al hashshavim! ma lechattat veasham – sheen mechapperin al hammezid kashshogeg; tomar leyom hakkippurim – shemmechapper al hammezid kashshogeg?!
Hoil umechapper al hammezid kashshogeg, yechapper al shavim veal sheenan shavim! talmud lomar: "ach" – chalak.
Setam sifra manni – rabbi yehuda; vekaamar: shavim in, lo shavim la.

Verame setam sifra assetam sifra – detanya: yachol lo yehe yom hakkippurim mechapper, ella im ken hitanna bo, ukerao mikra kodesh, velo asa bo melacha; lo hitanna bo, velo kerao mikra kodesh, veasa bo melacha – minnayin? talmud lomar: "yom kippurim hu" mikkol makom!
Amar abbaye: la kashya; ha rabbi, veha rabbi yehuda.
Rava amar: ha veha rabbi, umode rabbi becharet deyoma. dei la tema hachi, karet deyom hakkippurim lerabbi let leh.
Allema la? mashkachat la – kegon daavad belelya umit, dela ata yemama lechappore leh!
Ella ema:
b: Karet dimama lerabbi let leh.
Allema la? mashkachat la daachal umetza vechankeh umit; i name daachal samuch lishkiat hachamma – dela hava shehut lechappore leh!
Echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach.

Ha gufa kashya – katane: echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach; vahadar tane: ma ben yisrael lechohanim ulechohen mashuach! amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach mitkapperin besair hammishtalleach bishar averot, veen chilluk benehen. uma ben yisrael lechohanim ulechohen mashuach? ella shehappar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumeat mikdash vekadashav vechulei.

Umanni – rabbi yehuda hi. detanya: "vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh" – ze lifnay velifnim; "et ohel moed" – ze hechol; "mizbeach" – kemashmao; "yechapper" – ellu azarot; "kohanim" – kemashmao; "am hakkahal" – ellu yisrael; "yechapper" – ellu haleviyyim;
Hushevu kullan lechappara achat, shemmitkapperin besair hammishtalleach bishar averot. divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi shimon omer: keshem sheddam sair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumeat mikdash vekadashav. ucheshem shevvidduyo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael bishar averot, kach vidduyo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot.
Ulerabbi shimon, ha vadday hushevu! may hushevu – divne kappara ninhu; mihu kol chad vechad mechappar bidnafsheh.

May tameh derabbi shimon? dichtiv: "velakach et shene hasseirim" – ittakkash sair hammishtalleach lesair hannaase bifnim; ma sair hannaase bifnim eno mechapper al hakkohanim al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, dichtiv beh: "asher laam"; af sair hammishtalleach eno mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot.
Verabbi yehuda amar lach: lehachi ittakkush – sheyyihyu shavim bemare uvekoma uvedamim hu daata.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: "veshachat et seir hachattat asher laam" – sheen hakkohanim mitkapperin bo. uvamme mitkapperin? befaro shel aharon.
Yachol lo yitkapperu befaro shel aharon; shehare kevar neemar: "asher lo" – meatta en lahen kappara? keshehu omer: "yechapper al hakkohanim" – matzinu lahen kappara.
Bamma hen mitkapperin? mutav sheyyitkapperu befaro shel aharon – shehare huttar mikkelalo etzel beto, veal yitkapperu besair hannaase bifnim – shello huttar mikkelalo etzel beto.
Veim nafshecha lomar – hare hu omer: "bet aharon barchu et Adonai, bet hallevi barchu et Adonai, yire Adonai barchu et Adonai".

Man tanna? amar rabbi yirmeya: dela kerabbi yehuda; dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: "kohanim yesh lahen kappara besair hammishtalleach". umanni? rava amar: rabbi shimon hi, deamar: "kohanim en lahem kappara besair hammishtalleach".

Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, hachi kaamar: meatta en lahem kappara betumeat mikdash vekadashav? keshehu omer: "yechapper al hakkohanim", matzinu sheyyesh lahen kappara bishar averot; uchemo dematzinu sheyyesh lahen kappara bishar averot, kach yesh lahen kappara

a: Betumeat mikdash vekadashav. bamma hem mitkapperin? mutav sheyyitkapperu befaro shel aharon, shehare huttar mikkelalo etzel beto; veal yitkapperu besair hannaase bifnim, shehare lo huttar mikkelalo.
Veim nafshecha lomar – hare hu omer: "bet aharon barchu et Adonai vegomer".
Umay "im nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema "beto" ketiv – kullan keruyin "beto", shenneemar: "bet aharon barchu et Adonai, yire Adonai barchu et Adonai".
Vehay "asher laam" lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh dekaamar rachamana: middeam leheve! hahu miumeet adat bene yisrael" nafka.
Vehay "asher lo" – lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: mishshello hu mevi, veeno mevi mishshel tzibbur.

Yachol lo yavi mishshel tzibbur, sheen hatztzibbur mitkapperin bo; aval yavi mishshel echav hakkohanim, sheechav hakkohanim mitkapperin bo? talmud lomar: "asher lo". yachol lo yavi, veim hevi kasher? talmud lomar shuv "asher lo" – hakkatuv shana alav leakkev.
Tanna hachi ka kashya leh: may shena bidam – dela mikkapperi, dela ka chasri beh mamona, dichtiv "asher laam"; bidaharon name la ka chasri beh mamona! vekaamar: kullan keruyin "beto".
Bishlama lerabbi shimon, hayeynu dichtiv tere vidduyin vedam happar, chad keneged sair hannaase bifnim, vechad keneged sair hannaase bachutz, vechad keneged sair hammishtalleach;
Ella lerabbi yehuda, tere vidduyin vedam happar lema li? bechad vidduy vedamo sagya!
Echad lo, veechad leveto. kidtana deve rabbi yishmael: kach hi middat haddin noheget: mutav yavo zakkay vichapper al hachayyayv, veal yavo chayyayv vichapper al hachayyayv.
Hadaran alach shevuot shetayim
Mishna yediot hattumea shetayim shehen arba: nitma veyada, veneelma mimmennu hattumea vezachur et hakkodesh;
Nelam mimmennu hakkodesh vezachur et hattumea; neelmu mimmennu ze vaze; veachal et hakkodesh velo yada, umishsheachal yada – hare ze beole veyored.

Nitma veyada, veneelma mimmennu tumea vezachur et hammikdash; nelam mimmennu mikdash vezachur et hattumea; nelam mimmennu ze vaze; venichnas lammikdash velo yada, umishsheyyatza yada – hare ze beole veyored.
Echad hannichnas laazara veechad hannichnas letosefet haazara, sheen mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bemelech venavi veurim vetummim vesanhedrin shel shivim veechad, uvishte todot uveshir.
Uvet din mehallechin, ushete todot acharehen, vechol yisrael acharehem.
b: Happenimit neechelet, vehachitzona nisrefet. vechol shello naaset bechol ellu – hannichnas lesham en chayyayv aleha.

Nitma baazara, veneelma mimmennu tumea vezachur et hammikdash; nelam hemennu mikdash vezachur hattumea; nelam mimmennu ze vaze; vehishtachava o sheshshaha bichde hishtachavaa o ba lo baaruvka – chayyayv. bakketzara – patur.
Zo hi mitzvat ase shebbammikdash sheen chayyayvin aleha.
Veezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda shechayyayvin aleha? haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo "nitmeti", uferash miyyad – chayyayv, mippene sheyyetziato hanaa lo keviato.
Rabbi eliezer omer: "hashsheretz" – "venelam mimmennu", al helem sheretz chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem mikdash.
Rabbi akiva omer: "venelam mimmennu vehu tame" – al helem tumea chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem mikdash.
Rabbi yishmael omer: "venelam" "venelam" shete peamim, lechayyev al helem tumea veal helem mikdash.
Gemara amar rav pappa leabbaye: shetayim shehen arba?! shetayim shehen shesh havyayn – yediot hattumea techilla vasof, yediot hakkodesh techilla vasof, yediot mikdash techilla vasof!
Uletamaych, tamne havyayn – deha ikka tumea dekodesh vetumea demikdash techilla vasof!
Ha la kashya, shem tumea achat hi. mikkol makom shet havyayn!
Amar rav pappa: leolam tamne havyayn, arbee kammayayta, dela mayytan leh lide korban – la ka chashev; arbee batrayayta, demayytan leh lide korban – ka chashev.
Veikka deamri, amar rav pappa: leolam tamne havyayn; vearbee kammayayta, deletanhu bechol hattora kullah – ka chashev; arbee batrayayta, deitanhu bechol hattora kullah – la ka chashev.
Bae rav pappa: neelmu mimmennu hilchot tumea, mahu? hechi dame? illema dela yada i sheretz tame i tzefardea tame – zil keri be rav hu!

Leolam deyada betumeat sheretz; uchegon dinga bechaadasha, vela yada kaadasha i metamme i la metamme. may? kevan deyada dimtamme sheretz baolam – yedia hi; o dilma, kevan dechaadasha la yada i metamme i la metamme – haalama hi? teku.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: ben bavel sheala leeretz yisrael, venelam mimmennu mekom mikdash – mahu?
Allibba deman? i allibba derabbi akiva devae yedia battechilla – ha la mechayyev al helem mikdash! i allibba derabbi yishmael dimchayyev al helem mikdash – ha la bae yedia battechilla!

La tzericha; allibba derabbi – devae yedia battechilla, umechayyev al helem mikdash, veamar yediat bet rabbo shemah yedia. may? kevan deyada deikka mikdash baolam – yedia hi; o dilma, kevan dimkomo la yeda leh – haalama hi? teku.
Echad hannichnas laazara vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav shimi bar chiyyay, deamar kera: "kechol asher ani mare otcha, et tavnit hammishkan veet tavnit kol kelav

a: Vechen taasu" – ledorot.
Metiv rava: kol hakkelim sheasa moshe – meshichatan mekaddashtan, mikkan veelach – avodatan mechannachtan. veammay? venema "vechen taasu" – ledorot!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "vayyimshachem vaykaddesh otam" – otam bimshicha, velo ledorot bimshicha.
Ema otam – bimshicha, ledorot – o bimshicha o baavoda! amar rav pappa, amar kera: "asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh", telaan hakkatuv besherut.

Hasheta dichtav rachamana "asher yeshartu", "otam" lema li? i la ketav rachamana "otam", hava amena: hane hu devimshicha, ledorot – bimshicha uvaavoda, deha ketiv "vechen taasu"; miet rachamana "otam" – otam bimshicha, velo ledorot bimshicha.
Uvishte todot. tana: shete todot sheamru – belachman velo bivsaran. menahane mille? amar rav chisda, deamar kera: "vaaamida shete todot gedolot vetahaluchot layyamin meal lachoma".
May "gedolot"? illema mimmin gadol mammash, nema "parim"! ella gedolot beminan.

Mi ikka chashivuta kamme shemayya? vehatanya: neemar beolat behema "ishshe reach nichoach", beolat haof "ishshe reach nichoach", bemincha "ishshe reach nichoach"; melammed sheechad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven et libbo leaviv shebbashshamayim!
