Ella gedola shebbattoda, umay nihu – chametz. ditnan: hattoda hayta baa min chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot, shehen shesh midbariyyot, shehen shete efot; vehaefa shalosh sein, esrim issaron – asara lechametz vaasara lammatztza. uvammatztza shelosha minin: challot, rekikin urevucha.
Amar rame bar chama: en haazara mitkaddeshet, ella bishyare mincha. may tama? kirushalayim; ma yerushalayim – davar hanneechol bah mekaddeshah, af azara – davar hanneechol bah mekaddeshah.
Attu lachme toda, baazara mi la mitachli?! ella kirushalayim – ma yerushalayim davar hanneechol bah veyotze mimmenna nifsal, af azara davar hanneechol bah vehayyotze mimmenna nifsal.
I ma lehallan chametz, af kan chametz?! vetisbera? minchat chametz mi ikka?!
b: Vechi tema demachmetz lehu leshirayim umekaddesh behu – vehachtiv "lo teafe chametz chelkam", veamar resh lakish: afillu chelkam lo teafe chametz!
Allema la? efshar dimkaddesh bishte hallechem baatzeret! mishshum dela efshar.
Hechi nebed? nivneyeh meetmol venikaddesheh meetmol? shete hallechem bishchitat kevashim hu dekadshi.
Nivneyeh meetmol, venikaddesheh haiddana? baenan kiddush bishat habbinyan.
Nivneyeh beyom tov unekaddesheh beyom tov? en binyan mikdash doche yom tov.
Nishbeke levatar hachi, venivneyeh venikaddesheh? ippesila leh belina.

Nivneyeh mimmaale yoma uneshayyayr beh pureta – dead dekadesh yoma lealtar nigmereh venikaddesheh? en binyan bet hammikdash ballayla; deamar abbaye: minnayin sheen binyan bet hammikdash ballayla? shenneemar: "uveyom hakim et hammishkan" – beyom mekimo, ballayla en mekimo. hilkach la efshar.

Uveshir. tanu rabbanan: shir shel toda – bechinnorot uvinvalim uvetzeltzelim al kol pinna ufinna veal kol even gedola shebbirushalayim, veomer "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani vegomer", veshir shel pegaim, veyesh omrin shir shel negaim.
Man deamar dingaim – dichtiv: "venega lo yikrav beoholecha", uman deamar pegaim – dichtiv: "yippol mitztziddecha elef".

Veomer: "yoshev beseter elyon betzel shadday yitlonan" ad "ki atta Adonai machsi elyon samta meonecha"; vechozer veomer: "mizmor ledavid bevorcho mippene avshalom beno, Adonai ma rabbu tzaray", ad "laAdonai hayeshua al ammecha virchatecha sela".
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lehu lehane kerae, vegane. hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur lehitrappeot bedivre tora! lehagen shane.

Veella ki amar asur – deikka makka? i deikka makka asur, vetu la?! vehatnan: hallochesh al hammakka, en lo chelek laolam habba! ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yochanan: berokek shanu; lefi sheen mazkirin shem shamayim al harkika.

Bet din mehallechin ushete todot acharehen vechulei. lememra devet din kamme toda azli?! vehachtiv: "vayyelech acharehem hoshaya vachatzi sare yehuda"! hachi kaamar: bet din mehallechin, ushete todot mehallechot uvet din acharehem.

Ketzad mehallechot? rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi; chad amar: zo keneged zo, vechad amar: zo achar zo. man deamar zo keneged zo, "happenimit" – hach dimkarva lachoma. man deamar zo achar zo, "happenimit" – hach dimkarva levet din.

Tenan: happenimit neechelet vehachitzona nisrefet. bishlama leman deamar zo achar zo, ammetu lehachi penimit neechelet – mishshum deatya chitzona kamma, vekaddeshah la. ella leman deamar zo keneged zo, tarvayyhu bahade hadade ka meykaddeshi!
Velitamaych, leman deamar zo achar zo, chada mi meykaddesha?! ha "kol shello naaset bechol ellu" tenan! vaafillu leman deamar "beachat mikkol ellu", hane tarvayyhu chada mitzva hi!
Ella amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Al pi navi neechelet veal pi navi nisrefet.
Kol shello naaset bechol ellu kulei. ittemar, rav huna amar: "bechol ellu" tenan, rav nachman amar: "beachat mikkol ellu" tenan.
Rav huna amar "bechol ellu" tenan – kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo, veezra zecher bealma hu daavad.
Rav nachman amar "beachat mikkol ellu" tenan – kasavar: kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo, veezra kaddoshe kaddesh af al gav dela havo urim vetummim.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: "kol shello naaset bechol ellu"! tane: "beachat mikkol ellu".

Ta shema, abba shaul omer: shene bitzin hayu behar hammishcha, tachtona veelyona. tachtona – nitkaddesha bechol ellu; elyona – lo nitkaddesha bechol ellu, ella beole gola; shello bemelech veshello beurim vetummim.
Tachtona shehayta kedushshatah gemura – amme haaretz nichnasin lesham, veochlin sham kadashim kallim aval lo maaser sheni; vachaverim ochlim sham kadashim kallim umaaser sheni.

Elyona shello hayta kedushshatah gemura – amme haaretz hayu nichnasin sham, veochlin sham kadashim kallim aval lo maaser sheni; vachaverim en ochlin sham lo kadashim kallim velo maaser sheni. umippene ma lo kiddeshuha? sheen mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bemelech venavi veurim vetummim, uvesanhedrin shel shivim veechad, uvishte todot uveshir.
Velamma kiddeshuha? lamma kiddeshuha?! ha amrat lo kiddeshuha! ella lama hichnisuha? mippene shettorpah shel yerushalayim hayta, venocha hi likkavesh mishsham.
Tannae hi; detanya, amar rabbi eliezer: shamati keshehayu bonin bahechol, asu kelaim lahechol ukelaim laazarot. ella shebbahechol bonin mibbachutz, uvaazarot bonin mibbifnim.

Amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit, ochlin kodshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni af al pi sheen choma; mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo. lav mikkelal derabbi eliezer savar: lo kiddesha leatid lavo?

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: mimmay? dilma dechulle alma kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo, umar may dishmia leh kaamar, umar may dishmia leh kaamar. vechi tema: kelaim lerabbi eliezer lema li? litzniuta bealma.

Ella hane tannae – detanya, amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: lamma manu chachamim et ellu? shekkeshealu bene haggola, matzu ellu vekiddeshum. aval rishonot batlu mishshebbatla haaretz. alma kasavar: kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo.

Vrminhi, amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: vechi ellu bilvad hayu?! vahalo kevar neemar: "shishshim ir kol chevel argov mamlechet og babbashan, kol elle arim betzurot choma gevoha"! ella lamma manu chachamim et ellu – shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekiddeshum.
Kiddeshum hasheta?! ha amrinan lekamman dela tzericha lekaddoshe! ella matzu ellu umenaum.

Velo ellu bilvad, ella kol shettaale beyadcha masoret meavotecha shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun – kol mitzvot ellu nohagot bah, mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo. kashya derabbi yishmael bar yose adderabbi yishmael bar yose!

Ibbaet ema: tere tannae allibba derabbi yishmael bar yose; ibbaet ema: chada minnayyhu rabbi elazar bar yose amra. detanya, rabbi elazar bar yose omer: "asher lo choma" – af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen.
b: Nitma baazara veneelma mimmennu tumea vechulei. tumea baazara menalan? amar rabbi elazar, katuv echad omer: "et mishkan Adonai timme", vechatuv echad omer: "ki et mikdash Adonai timme"; im eno inyan letumea shebbachutz, tenehu inyan letumea shebbifnim.

Ukerae meyatteri?! ha mitzrach tzerichi! detanya, rabbi elazar omer: im neemar "mishkan", lamma neemar "mikdash"? veim neemar "mikdash", lamma neemar "mishkan"? illu neemar "mishkan" velo neemar "mikdash", hayiti omer: al mishkan yehe chayyayv – shehare mashuach beshemen hammishcha, veal mikdash lo yehe chayyayv. veim neemar "mikdash" velo neemar "mishkan", hayiti omer: al mikdash yehe chayyayv – shehare kedushshato kedushshat olam, veal mishkan lo yehe chayyayv. lechach neemar "mishkan", lechach neemar "mikdash".
Rabbi elazar hachi ka kashya leh: mikkedi mishkan ikkeri "mikdash" umikdash ikkeri "mishkan"; nichtov o idde veidde "mikdash", o idde veidde "mishkan"! "mishkan" umikdash" lema li? shema minna tarte.

Bishlama mikdash ikkeri mishkan – dichtiv: "venatatti mishkani betochchem"; ella mishkan deikkeri mikdash – menalan? illema middichtiv: "venasu hakkehatim nose hammikdash" – hahu bearon ketiv! ella mehacha: "veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham", uchetiv: "kechol asher ani mare otcha et tavnit hammishkan".
Vehishtachava o sheshshaha kede hishtachavaa. amar rava: lo shanu ella shehishtachava kelappe fenim, aval hishtachava kelappe chutz – shaha in, lo shaha la.

Ikka dematne la assefa: o sheshshaha bichde hishtachavaa – mikkelal dehishtachavaa gufa baaya shehiyyay; amar rava: lo shanu ella shehishtachava kelappe chutz, aval kelappe fenim – af al gav delo shaha. vehachi kaamar: hishtachava kelappe fenim, o sheshshaha kede hishtachavaa behach hishtachavaa dichlappe chutz – chayyayv.
Hechi dame hishtachavaa deit ba shehiyyay, vehechi dame hishtachavaa delet ba shehiyyay? delet ba shehiyyay – zo keria bealma hi, deit bah shehiyyay – pishshut yadayim veraglayim.

Vechamma shiur shehiyyay? peligi ba rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani vechad deimmeh, umannu – rabbi shimon ben pazzi; veamri la rabbi shimon ben pazzi vechad deimmeh, umannu – rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani, veamri la rabbi shimon bar nachmani. chad amar: kememreh dehay pesuka, vechad amar: kemivvayichreu" lesefa. "vechol bene yisrael roim beredet haesh uchevod Adonai al habbayit, vayyichreu appayim artza al haritzfa, vayyishtachavu vehodot laAdonai ki tov ki leolam chasdo".

Tanu rabbanan: kidda – al appayim, vechen hu omer: "vattikkod bat sheva appayim eretz". keria – al birkayim, vechen hu omer: "mikkeroa al birkav". hishtachavaa – zo pishshut yadayim veraglayim, vechen omer: "havo navo ani veimmecha veachecha lehishtachavot lecha artza".
Bae rava: tzarich shehiyyay lemalkut, o en tzarich shehiyyay lemalkut? lekorban gemiri shehiyyay, lemalkut la gemiri shehiyyay;
